reuse.why: Fintegra reuses bank lookup and shared linking, but copies Akahu's downloader and the existing unlink field-reset logic.

duplication.why: The new downloader duplicates an existing provider implementation, and account unlink state is now defined independently in two places.

placement.why: Changes follow the existing account, sync, configuration and model layers, although common validation requires separate orchestration in every provider handler.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested linking rules, Fintegra support and associated tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: Shared validation and linking provide a useful foundation, but duplicated unlink semantics and another copied downloader create avoidable maintenance obligations.

bypasses_abstraction.where: app.ts: unlinkReplacedAccounts independently reproduces unlinkAccount's local reset instead of extracting a shared local-unlink operation used by both paths.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts: downloadFintegraTransactions renames downloadAkahuTransactions while retaining its implementation; app.ts: unlinkReplacedAccounts wraps unlinkAccount's field reset in a loop.

abstraction_drift.where: LinkAccountBaseParams gains replaceExistingLink and linkBankSyncAccount gains replacedIds; assertBankAccountNotLinked adds a replacement-dependent refusal branch, while unlinkReplacedAccounts creates one independent path around the existing unlink operation.
